ayahs.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا
ayahs.en: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
ayahs.tr: Waz-zaariyaati zarwaa

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا
ayahs.en: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
ayahs.tr: Falhaamilaati wiqraa

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا
ayahs.en: And those [ships] sailing with ease
ayahs.tr: Faljaariyaati yusraa

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
ayahs.en: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
ayahs.tr: Falmuqassimaati amraa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ
ayahs.en: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
ayahs.tr: Innamaa too'adoona la-saadiq

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
ayahs.en: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
ayahs.tr: Wa innad deena la waaqi'

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
ayahs.en: By the heaven containing pathways,
ayahs.tr: Wassamaaa'i zaatil hubuk

ayahs.ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ
ayahs.en: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
ayahs.tr: Innakum lafee qawlim mukhtalif

ayahs.ar: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
ayahs.en: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.
ayahs.tr: Yu'faku 'anhu man ufik

ayahs.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
ayahs.en: Destroyed are the falsifiers
ayahs.tr: Qutilal kharraasoon

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ
ayahs.en: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
ayahs.tr: Allazeena hum fee ghamratin saahoon

ayahs.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.en: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
ayahs.tr: Yas'aloona ayyaana yawmud Deen

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
ayahs.en: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
ayahs.tr: Yawma hum 'alan naari yuftanoon

ayahs.ar: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
ayahs.en: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
ayahs.tr: Zooqoo fitnatakum haa zal lazee kuntum bihee tas ta'jiloon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
ayahs.tr: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ayahs.ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.en: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
ayahs.tr: Aakhizeena maaa aataahum Rabbuhum; innahum kaanoo qabla zaalika muhsineen

ayahs.ar: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
ayahs.en: They used to sleep but little of the night,
ayahs.tr: kaanoo qaleelam minal laili maa yahja'oon

ayahs.ar: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
ayahs.tr: Wa bilashaari hum yastaghfiroon

ayahs.ar: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
ayahs.en: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
ayahs.tr: Wa feee amwaalihim haqqul lissaaa'ili walmahroom

ayahs.ar: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
ayahs.en: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
ayahs.tr: Wa fil ardi aayaatul lilmooqineen

ayahs.ar: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
ayahs.tr: Wa feee anfusikum; afalaa tubsiroon

ayahs.ar: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
ayahs.tr: Wa fissamaaa'i rizqukum wa maa too'adoon

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.en: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
ayahs.tr: Fawa Rabbis samaaa'i wal ardi innahoo lahaqqum misla maa annakum tantiqoon

ayahs.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
ayahs.en: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
ayahs.tr: Hal ataaka hadeesu daifi Ibraaheemal mukrameen

ayahs.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.en: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.
ayahs.tr: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun qawmum munkaroon

ayahs.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
ayahs.en: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
ayahs.tr: Faraagha ilaaa ahlihee fajaaa'a bi'ijlin sameen

ayahs.ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.en: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
ayahs.tr: Faqarrabahooo ilaihim qaala alaa taakuloon

ayahs.ar: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.en: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
ayahs.tr: Fa awjasa minhm khee fatan qaaloo laa takhaf wa bashsharoohu bighulaamin 'aleem

ayahs.ar: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.en: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
ayahs.tr: Fa aqbalatim ra-atuhoo fee sarratin fasakkat wajhahaa wa qaalat 'ajoozun 'aqeem

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.en: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki innahoo huwal hakeemul 'aleem

ayahs.ar: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
ayahs.tr: Qaala famaa khatbukum ayyuhal mursaloon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
ayahs.tr: Qaalooo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen

ayahs.ar: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
ayahs.en: To send down upon them stones of clay,
ayahs.tr: Linursila 'alaihim hijaa ratam min teen

ayahs.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.en: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
ayahs.tr: Musawwamatan 'inda rabbika lilmusrifeen

ayahs.ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.en: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.
ayahs.tr: Fa akhrajnaa man kaana feehaa minal mu'mineen

ayahs.ar: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
ayahs.tr: Famaa wajadnaa feehaa ghaira baitim minal muslimeen

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
ayahs.en: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
ayahs.tr: Wa taraknaa feehaaa aayatal lillazeena yakhaafoonal 'azaabal aleem

ayahs.ar: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.en: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
ayahs.tr: Wa fee Moosaaa iz arsalnaahu ilaa Fir'wna bisultaa nim mubeen

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.en: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."
ayahs.tr: Fatawalla biruknihee wa qaala saahirun aw majnoon

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.en: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
ayahs.tr: Fa akhaznaahu wa junoo dahoo fanabaznaahum fil yammi wa huwa muleem

ayahs.ar: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
ayahs.en: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
ayahs.tr: Wa fee 'Aadin iz arsalnaa 'alaihimur reehal'aqeem

ayahs.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
ayahs.en: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
ayahs.tr: Maa tazaru min shai'in atat 'alaihi illaa ja'alat hu karrameem

ayahs.ar: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.en: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
ayahs.tr: Wa fee Samooda iz qeela lahum tamatta''oo hattaa heen

ayahs.ar: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.en: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
ayahs.tr: Fa'ataw 'an amri Rabbihim fa akhazal humus saa'iqatu wa hum yanzuroon

ayahs.ar: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
ayahs.en: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
ayahs.tr: Famas tataa'oo min qiyaaminw wa maa kaanoo muntasireen

ayahs.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.en: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
ayahs.tr: Wa qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaano qawman faasiqeen

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
ayahs.en: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
ayahs.tr: Wassamaaa'a banainaa haa bi aydinw wa innaa lamoosi'oon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.en: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
ayahs.tr: Wal arda farashnaahaa fani'mal maahidoon

ayahs.ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.en: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
ayahs.tr: Wa min kulli shai'in khalaqnaa zawjaini la'allakum tazakkaroon

ayahs.ar: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.en: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
ayahs.tr: Fafirrooo ilal laahi innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.en: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
ayahs.tr: Wa laa taj'aloo ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.en: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
ayahs.tr: Kazaalika maaa atal lazeena min qablihim mir Rasoolin illaa qaaloo saahirun aw majnoon

ayahs.ar: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.en: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
ayahs.tr: Atawaasaw bih; bal hum qawmun taaghoon

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
ayahs.en: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
ayahs.tr: Fatawalla 'anhum famaaa anta bimaloom

ayahs.ar: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.en: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
ayahs.tr: Wa zakkir fa innaz zikraa tanfa'ul mu'mineen

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
ayahs.en: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
ayahs.tr: Wa maa khalaqtul jinna wal insa illaa liya'budoon

ayahs.ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
ayahs.en: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
ayahs.tr: Maaa ureedu minhum mir rizqinw wa maaa ureedu anyyut'imoon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
ayahs.tr: Innal laaha Huwar Razzaaqu Zul Quwwatil Mateen

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
ayahs.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
ayahs.tr: Fa inna lillazeena zalamoo zanoobam misla zanoobi ashaabihim falaa yasta'jiloon

ayahs.ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
ayahs.tr: Fawailul lillazeena kafaroo miny yawmihimul lazee yoo'adoon
